description: Rename an automation email subject and/or move it to an existing editable trip, activity, hosting (lodging), or transportation. Supply subject or exactly one move target. A move clears previous associations and attaches the email only to that target; do not supply trip_id alongside an item id. Attached emails disappear from the manual-review inbox. The API may return an empty successful response. Safety: Open-world: conservatively covers moves of externally received booking email content and attachments into shared trip records accessible to destination-trip collaborators. The MCP handler only updates the stored Tripsy email record; it does not send email or modify a provider mailbox. Destructive: can overwrite the subject or clear prior parent associations when moving an email, removing it from the manual-review inbox. Moves require exactly one editable target.

activity_id.description: Move to this editable activity. Supply exactly one move target; no trip_id is needed.

hosting_id.description: Move to this editable hosting (lodging). Supply exactly one move target; no trip_id is needed.

subject.description: Optional replacement subject. Omitted values preserve the existing subject.

transportation_id.description: Move to this editable transportation. Supply exactly one move target; no trip_id is needed.

trip_id.description: Move to this editable trip. Supply exactly one move target; omit when moving to an activity, hosting, or transportation.
